item.description:
Deckz now keeps itself up to date.

It looks for a new version when it starts, and once a day after that. When one exists it tells you what changed and asks; nothing is installed without you saying so. There is a "Check for Updates…" item in the menu for when you would rather ask than wait, and a switch in Settings → General if you would rather it install on its own.

Updating restarts Deckz. If you have windows in workspaces you are not looking at, those windows come back to the main display when it reopens — so the update window tells you how many will move before anything happens.

This version has to be installed by hand, the same way you installed the last one. No version before this one has any way to update itself, which is the thing this version adds. From here on it is a button.
